parent_task_worker_exception_cause.root_cause: worker_exception on agent_jordanh-gke is consistent with missing Python package dependencies in the system Python environment. When src/mac/ modules are imported using the system Python3 (outside the project .venv), missing packages including yaml (PyYAML), fastapi, cryptography, and numpy cause ModuleNotFoundError on import. The .venv created by bootstrap (python3 scripts/bootstrap-project.py) correctly resolves all dependencies. If agent_jordanh-gke ran the task executor with the wrong Python interpreter (system Python instead of .venv), or if bootstrap was not run/failed silently, any import of mac.services, mac.worker, mac.cli, mac.api, etc. would raise an unhandled exception that the worker catches and records as worker_exception. The codebase itself has no broken imports when executed within the .venv.
parent_task_worker_exception_cause.import_errors_with_venv_python: None - all imports succeed correctly within .venv
parent_task_worker_exception_cause.remediation: Ensure python3 scripts/bootstrap-project.py runs successfully on agent_jordanh-gke before task execution, and that the task executor invokes .venv/bin/python (not system python3).
